key_insight: OpenThoughts-Agent proposes a fully open pipeline for curating training data for agentic language models, aiming to build agents that generalize across many tasks instead of overfitting to a single benchmark. The core idea is that better data recipes can unlock more capable and broadly useful AI agents.
problem_solved: Current open-source agent training efforts often focus on one benchmark or narrow task family, making it hard to create models that transfer well to diverse real-world agentic tasks. This paper addresses the lack of a public, general-purpose data curation strategy for agentic models.
method: Builds an open data curation pipeline for agentic model training.
Targets diverse agentic tasks rather than optimizing for one benchmark.
Focuses on data recipes that support broad generalization across agent behaviors and environments.
impact: For AI/ML practitioners, this work provides a transparent blueprint for creating stronger agent datasets and training pipelines. It can help teams develop models that are more robust, reusable, and better suited for real-world agentic applications.
visual_elements: Pipeline diagram showing data collection, filtering, and training stages
Comparison chart of single-benchmark vs multi-task generalization
Agent workflow icons representing diverse tasks/environments
Before-and-after illustration of narrow vs broadly capable agents
paper_title: OpenThoughts-Agent: Data Recipes for Agentic Models
paper_authors: Negin Raoof, Richard Zhuang, Marianna Nezhurina, Etash Guha, Atula Tejaswi
